title: World identity laws and proposed start qualification

reviews.classification: full actual map review; carrier, experience dial, source confidence and runtime states separated
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full277-line map actually read, including every171-row source/world/volume comparison, IL1–IL35, schema, qualification sequence and limits. The initial oversized1–140 output was truncated and was not credited; bounded1–20/21–40/41–60/61–80/81–110/111–140 recovered it before continuing141–277. This reads the map, not all linked dossiers or underlying books. SHOWN here attributes an earlier local dossier scene; STATED wiki remains secondary. No source-canon claim was independently requalified in this review.

F2: IL1–IL3 and IL16–IL28 preserve body, soul, mind/memory, controller, representation, social/legal identity and actual carrier distinctions. Duplication, mind copy, split, soul swap, merge, occupation, remnant, regression and reincarnation are not interchangeable operations. Position swap, technique copying, power-key sharing, core splitting or a lookalike does not prove personal continuity. None/Implied/Present/Playable is an experience proposal, not a cosmological prohibition or runtime-support level. None cannot erase prior independently played residents; a source-grounded shared-soul autonomous copy must not be forced into a universal new-soul template.

F3: Preserve the world-specific differences rather than importing one shared-self rule: shared-reserve simulacra and avatars, independent partitioned selves, remote reserve vessels, record-derived summons, remnant power, reincarnating concepts, body reconstruction, private simulation and memory-only return have distinct control, retention and coexistence contracts. Matching face or genome is not universal authentication; shared soul need not share all knowledge. Source claims stay bound to their stated era/edition, local scene and confidence. WN/LN, source adaptation, sequel and alternate continuity remain separate; later stronger means can change a previous limit without backporting all future capabilities into an early start.

F4: UNKNOWN rows and synopsis-only Implied rows preserve useful opportunities without establishing impossibility, valid methods or automatic feature tickets. The broad ordinary-first wording is a dated lane boundary; current Klein developer-route/HP direction controls active build order, with low-spoiler ordinary starts separately owned. The171-entry denominator includes motifs and volume rows, not171 implemented worlds or fully read editions. The separate five-book identities remain named and independently bounded. Soldier pause is not lifted by an inventory row. Source gaps for HP, Bleach, LOTM avatars, Roshar and Elden Ring need only the exact consequential route evidence before that exceptional operation, not a universal hold on world entry or the entire project.

F5: IL21–IL26 correctly reject automatic cosmic policing, deletion or fusion from resemblance. Preserve custody and independent actor histories, real detection and responding authority, concrete source/world law and exception means. Item recollection does not duplicate an actual item, while an explicit legitimate creation/duplication mechanism remains possible under AD22/AD38. A source's ordinary uniqueness statement is not a universal no-exception engine rule. No mandatory backlash, balancing cost, loss or moral classification follows merely from coexisting selves. Destructive occupation versus sharing is a real effect with an actual former-occupant outcome, whose public disclosure remains observer-qualified.

F6: IL29/IL30's versioned law and entity binding are proposed seam shapes, not accepted new save fields or a permission-list implementation. Existing actor/body/source/knowledge/custody owners should carry actual facts; add only the first useful selected consumer under AD51. Admission needs the actual mechanism and affected carrier, not a category name substituting for causal feasibility. Unknown author truth may be validated privately while public offers show known commitments/cues through sealed references. Hidden binding, titles and provenance must not leak truth. A supported original contract can settle an unknown source route when explicitly labelled, without pretending it is canon.

F7: IL31–IL35 are optional future examples, not a required multi-world prototype or source-reading wave. Keep their useful tests of shared fuel versus partitioned memory, former-occupant consequence, two minds/one item, stable identity, real recognition and travel return. Current AD35/AD36/AD42/AD43 scope evidence; no gameplay, source acquisition, save access, sealed-file preview, native UI, migration, commit or push occurred. Exact IL12 remains source-qualified because world-depth31 also uses that code. Original source locators and dated uncertainty remain history rather than being deleted.

reviews.reopen: Only changed map content or a selected exact exceptional start needs scoped law/source and native validation.
